sourceIssues.printed: "For a cusp [𝒜] ∈ C₀(𝔠, 𝔫), the normalized constant term c_𝒜(0, W_k(ψ_𝔓, 1)) equals 𝔱 · τ(ψ)/N𝔠₀^k · sgn(N(−c)) ψ(𝔠_𝒜) · L(ψ^{−1}, 1−k)/2^n · ∏_{𝔭|𝔓}(1 − ψ(𝔭)/N𝔭^k) · ∏_{𝔩∈J_𝔱}(1 − ψ(𝔩)) · ∏_{𝔩∈J_𝔱^c}(1 − N𝔩^k)."
sourceIssues.correction: Delete the leading 𝔱: c_𝒜(0, W_k(ψ_𝔓, 1)) = τ(ψ)/N𝔠₀^k · sgn(N(−c)) ψ(𝔠_𝒜) · L(ψ^{−1}, 1−k)/2^n · ∏_{𝔭|𝔓}(1 − ψ(𝔭)/N𝔭^k) · ∏_{𝔩∈J_𝔱}(1 − ψ(𝔩)) · ∏_{𝔩∈J_𝔱^c}(1 − N𝔩^k).
sourceIssues.reason: The auxiliary ideal 𝔱=∏_{𝔩∈T}𝔩 in §8.1 is not a scalar. More decisively, applying Proposition 8.4 to Definition 8.2 gives the common scalar prefactor times Σ_{𝔪|𝔱} μ(𝔪)∏_{𝔩∈J_𝔪}ψ(𝔩)∏_{𝔩∈J_𝔪^c}(N𝔩)^k. Since 𝔱 is squarefree, this sum is ∏_{𝔩∈J_𝔱}(1−ψ(𝔩))∏_{𝔩∈J_𝔱^c}(1−(N𝔩)^k). Thus deletion, not replacement by N𝔱, is the correction. The proof on p.53 has exactly this scalar expression. In the earlier February copy, the auxiliary ideal is named 𝔩 and the prime index is 𝔮; its p.53 display has no extra auxiliary-ideal factor. The arXiv TeX at label p:nop literally begins the display with \ft. Extraction item 221 already uses the corrected statement.

review.reason: Independently checked fresh PDF page images in all three named preprints, arXiv TeX, Definitions 8.2–8.3, Proposition 8.4, Remark 8.5, and the Proposition 8.6 proof. Expanding the squarefree divisor sum proves the proposed deletion. Proposition 8.11 equation (101) uses the corrected value, so misprint/affects nothing is appropriate in §18’s intended-mathematics sense. Kept the correction and reach; clarified the older notation, page count, search scope, and that the journal version remains unverified. This verdict confirms E1 only in arXiv v3 and the May author copy, not persistence in the published article. No additional finding established in the inspected passages.
